name: FFmpeg Multimedia Processing Suite
purpose: Comprehensive CLI utility for video normalization, audio stream concatenation, multi-track multiplexing, and filter-based QA auditing.
capabilities: Lossless video/audio multiplexing with stream copying
Audio mixing with volume ducking (amix filter complex)
blackdetect filter for seamless crossfade gap verification

installation.instructions: Installed globally via brew install ffmpeg.

compatibility.notes: Hardware-accelerated encoding supported via Apple VideoToolbox if needed.

licensing.notes: Standard GPL build used as external CLI tool without linking.

approval_evidence: Production certified in Stage 8 multiplexing and Stage 9 QA gates.
